notes: Fruit rarity tiers, transformation powers, trading and island combat with simple quests make this a levelling combat RPG rather than a plain explorable region, which is how the skill reads a Blox Fruits reference, so RPG leads with Adventure named second for the island-hopping exploration. Shape is world-open-biomes because the three seas are regions of rising power that the author says you reach by talking to an NPC and arriving as if you had rejoined somewhere else, so the P4 is earned by the prompt rather than something to override, and each sea holds five islands visible across the ocean as an island-cluster. Preset Open World & Survival RPG keeps its shape and its fruit-spawn collectibles and landmarks; I dropped buildzone-plot because nothing here is player-built, and its genre caveat that danger should be a gradient rather than a fence is bent on purpose since the author gated sea-to-sea travel behind an NPC. Deciding without a user: the transformation and trading rooms are entered, so P3 stands, and the ocean between islands is sailed across a surface rather than a self-occluding volume, so the island CHECK should clear.
